signals_info.description: Normalized risk for the selected pedestrian or cyclist; values above 0.7 form the selected high-risk predicate.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the vulnerable-road-user risk shall be less than or equal to 0.7.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，弱势道路使用者风险应小于或等于 0.7。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The assessed pedestrian-or-cyclist risk shall be no greater than 0.7 now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 行人或骑行者风险评估值应在当前或之后某个时刻不高于 0.7。
